description: Artifact-defined reference predicate SatPsi. For each retained contract-atom set T subseteq I, the reference artifact is produced by a SEPARATE generator (scripts/contract_realization.py) authored directly from contract-atom meaning (PC/IB retention) with different surface syntax (named contract predicates), NOT by feeding betaSet(T) into the implementation-lever renderer. SatPsi_scope(T) is the MEASURED verification outcome of that independently generated artifact. Implementation and contract residual source hashes differ (see cross_realization in results/reportability_audit_<scope>.json), so ResidualFaithfulness is a cross-realization conformance check rather than a construction tautology.
realization_independence: implementation residuals: scripts/generate_dafny_variants.py (levers T,P,D); reference-contract residuals: scripts/contract_realization.py (atoms PC,IB). Different generators, different source hashes, conformance compared via ResidualFaithfulness.
faithfulness_detection_scope: A realization defect that changes the measured feasibility outcome on one side but not the corresponding outcome on the other side is detected as a ResidualFaithfulness failure. Correlated defects (the same conceptual error on both sides) and defects that preserve all measured Boolean outcomes may remain undetected.
pc_deletion_semantics: Deleting ORIGINAL_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_SURFACE is a mixed-direction transformation, not a relaxation: Trend is strengthened (span !=0 => >0, domain shrinks) while Percent is weakened (whole >0 => !=0, domain grows). This mixed direction is why Psi-deletion monotonicity fails in the closed-world scope.
residual_faithfulness_check: forall T subseteq I: SatPhi(betaSet(T)) iff SatPsi(T), decided row-by-row across all 4 T in results/reportability_audit_<scope>.json
